script_line: Two centimetres below your kneecap there is a band of tendon about as wide as your thumb. Every step you take lands on it. Seventeen times your bodyweight.

risks.risk: the red spreads over the whole knee
risks.prevented_by: the band of tendon under the kneecap flashes as one band; no red spreading

risks.risk: the leg bends too far and the anatomy breaks
risks.prevented_by: the knee gives a little; HOLD-AC
flashes at the moment of load; no gradual onset
